# Rize

Rize is an AI-powered time tracking and productivity tool that automatically tracks your work time and provides insights.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/rize/.

## Actions

- **Create a Rize counterparty**: Creates a new Counterparty in the Rize system.
- **Create API Key**: Create a new API key for the partner.
- **Create Card**: Creates a new card in the Rize system.
- **Create Cardholder**: Creates a new cardholder in the Rize system.
- **Create Partner Financial Account**: Create a new financial account for an existing partner in the Rize admin API.
- **Create User**: Creates a new user in the Rize system.
- **Get Cardholder** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific cardholder using their unique identifier.
- **Get Virtual Card Image** (read-only): Retrieves the virtual card image asset.
